name: Caverton
source: CRON 20261014: Caverton Offshore Support Group Plc unaudited consolidated statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), Group column, thousands of naira scaled to naira. Revenue less the operating expenses line equals the line the filing labels Operating Profit, and that less administrative expenses plus net exchange difference plus other operating income equals the printed Total Operating Profit/(Loss); that total less net finance cost equals the printed profit before income tax and less the printed income tax equals the printed loss for the period. The filing has no cost of sales line, so the operating expenses line is stored as Cost of Sales and the line the filing labels Operating Profit is stored as Gross Profit. EPS in naira per share. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | Cost of Sales stored as 0.0 against a non-zero Revenue was replaced by Revenue minus Gross Profit (FY2024, FY2025); the zero was a failed parse, not a figure | CRON 2026-10-06: 3 blank cell(s) filled from https://stockanalysis.com/quote/ngx/CAVERTON/financials/income-statement/ . Every value this file already stored agreed with that page within 0.5%, so the fill is additive. Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit and Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit were re-checked per period; Net Profit was withheld where the source's own figures do not tie. | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 column from the Caverton Offshore Support Group Plc unaudited statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 September 2026, NGX doclib, group year to September column, printed in N thousand and stored as absolute naira. Revenue 20,736,093; operating expenses 11,865,435 plus administrative expenses 12,760,527 gives operating expenses 24,625,962; net exchange difference 1,692,341 and other operating income 55,867 printed above the total; total operating loss 2,253,395; net finance cost 11,492,284; loss before income tax 13,745,679; income tax 47,700; loss for the period 13,793,379; basic EPS printed as 4.12 negative naira. Ties exactly. | CRON 20261120_0501: 9M 2026 cells from the issuer Q3 2026 filing in the NGX doclib library (doclib.ngxgroup.com), entity and period column named in the note. EPS None to -4.08.

unitGuard.reason: unit guard refused: the EPS for 9M 2026 reads -4120 and the earnings triangle would put it at -4.12 (a factor of 1001), but that triangle rests on a net profit of 5.02318e+10 against a market capitalisation of 1.474e+10 (3.408x of FY2025), so the row that is in the wrong unit is the EARNINGS row and not the EPS row. Both are left exactly as filed; the guard does not pick between them.

rows.unitGuardBasis: factor = stored EPS / (the same period's net profit / shares on file); a factor within 15% of a power of ten (or its reciprocal) whose corrected value lands within 2.0x of the triangle is a UNIT error and is normalised; a stored cell of the opposite sign to the period's net profit whose magnitude is beyond 5.0x is WITHHELD with both figures named; every other cell is left exactly as filed
